symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit surface

symptoms: Bright yellow-orange spots on upper leaf surfaces in spring

culturalManagement: Maintain routine pruning, weeding, and balanced fertilizing

symptoms: Uniform green leaves without spots or wilting

symptoms: White powdery fungal coating on leaves and young shoots

symptoms: Clean, intact dark green foliage

पाउडर जैसा रस्ट हाथ लगाने पर झड़ता है

symptoms: Long elliptical grayish-green cigar-shaped lesions (2.5 to 15 cm long)

Rotate with soybean or pulses

symptoms: Lush green undamaged leaf blades

Apply protective copper or organic sprays before bloom

symptoms: Interveinal yellowing and browning producing a distinctive 'tiger-stripe' leaf pattern

अंगूर के दानों पर छोटे काले धब्बे

symptoms: Irregular reddish-brown lesions on leaf surfaces

symptoms: Smooth intact vine foliage

symptomsHindi: स्वस्थ और साफ पत्तियां
